title: Technique
description: One technique, motif, process or tool that starts in one domain and moves into others. A style does not own it: the technique names the styles that use it, and each adoption gives the domain, the year and the route.

kind.description: montage: a cut or a join of images in time or on a sheet. animation: a rule for movement. motif: a form that is repeated as decoration. material: a surface or a substance. process: a way of making. tool: an instrument.

how.description: Rules to apply the technique. Each rule names a property and a measure.

year.description: The first year with a firm record. A negative year is BCE.

circa.description: true when the year is an estimate.

adoptions.description: Each move into a domain, in order of year. The build adds lag_years = year − origin.year.

via.description: The person, work, tool or medium that carried the technique across.

styles.description: Style ids in this domain that take it up at this step.
Every style id, in any domain, that uses the technique. The skill of each style lists the technique.

principles.description: Composition principle ids from data/principles/ that the technique serves.
